newsitem.title: USA: SunAmerica, NBC Sports in sponsor deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: SunAmerica, NBC Sports in sponsor deal - WSJ.

text.p: Retirement savings company SunAmerica Inc and General Electric's NBC Sports have signed a key new sponsorship deal, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.
The agreement was expected to be announced today, the paper said, citing people familiar with the deal.
SunAmerica said its commercials and promotions would run over 230 times during the next year on NBC sporting events, the paper said.

The network would display the SunAmerica logo in a new show of highlights and updates called "SunAmerica NBC Sports Desk," the paper said. It has named its football wrap-up report the "SunAmerica NFL Post-Game Report," it said.
